# Island Rides Phuket

> Motorbike, scooter and car rental shop in Chalong, Phuket, Thailand. Also books island tours, adventure tours, ferry tickets, and helps with visas and Thai driver licenses. Contact on WhatsApp +66 80 314 0043 or LINE: islandrides. Open Mon–Sat 09:30–19:00, Sun 09:30–18:00.

Address: 7 Chalong 10, Soi Ta-iad, Chalong, Mueang Phuket, Phuket 83130, Thailand. Rated 5.0 on Google.

## Rentals
- [Motorbike rental](https://www.islandridesphuket.com/motorcycle-rental): Honda Click 125/160, PCX 160, ADV 160, ADV 350, Forza 350, X-ADV 750, Yamaha NMAX, Aerox, XMAX. From 300 THB/day (low season). Helmets, phone holder and insurance included.
- [Honda ADV 350 rental](https://www.islandridesphuket.com/honda-adv-350-rental): from 750 THB/day or 12,000 THB/month in low season.
- [Honda X-ADV 750 rental](https://www.islandridesphuket.com/honda-x-adv-750-rental): Akrapovic exhaust on every bike, from 1,400 THB/day in low season.
- [Car rental](https://www.islandridesphuket.com/car-rental) and [Ford Ranger Raptor rental](https://www.islandridesphuket.com/ford-ranger-raptor-rental): 2,500 THB/day, first-class insurance.

Seasons: low season 1 May – 31 Oct, high season 1 Nov – 30 Apr (minimum 3 days).
